What's included

Comparable sales
Ranked by distance, size, age and how recently they sold, each with a match score.
ARV and repairs
Repairs by condition, adjusted for the age of the house, or your exact repair lines.
Mortgage, equity and liens
Recorded loans, estimated balance and equity, liens, pre-foreclosure filings and auction dates.
Payoff check
A warning when what the seller owes is above your max offer, before you call.
Opening and max offer
Max offer = ARV × 70% − repairs − your fee. Your opening offer starts 5% below that.
Vacant lots
Priced per acre, adjusted for utilities, access and flood zone.
Batch analysis
Up to 10 addresses at once, sorted by score, with CSV export.
Buyer pitch written for you
An email and text for your buyers, without the exact address.

Questions

Still have questions?Talk to the founder for 15 minutes. We'll walk through how you'd use it.Hop on a call
Where do the numbers come from?

Property details and recent sales come from public records and listing data covering the U.S. ARV is based on the closest recent sales by distance, size, age and date. Every number is an estimate, so check comps and walk the property before you sign.

Can I change the numbers?

Yes. On any deal you can change the ARV, repairs, contract price and fee and see your buyer's profit update.
